notes:
SA3 LoRA training now runs the official stable-audio-3 trainer.
New option to train on full tracks instead of random crops.
The shared trigger word is prepended to captions instead of replacing them - retrain trigger LoRAs made on older versions.
New LoRAs and checkpoint switches apply without reopening the add loras popup.
Lower VRAM use while training. Compatible with gary4juce v4.0.7.
